decls.name: nu
decls.rationale: Formalizes the unit-distance count \(\nu(P)\): `nu P` counts the non-diagonal elements of `Finset.sym2 P` (i.e. unordered pairs of distinct points of `P`) whose endpoints are at distance 1.

decls.name: nuMax
decls.rationale: Formalizes \(\nu(n)\), the maximum of \(\nu(P)\) over all n-point planar sets, as the supremum of `nu P` over `P : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))` with `P.card = n`.
